text: dsh-diff-view 是面向 DSH Web 客户端插件的可复用文本差异查看服务。它在浏览器端提供 diffView 服务，包含行级 LCS 差异引擎和可独立使用的差异组件。主要功能有双栏或统一视图、按 hunk 分组并折叠未变化区间、准确显示两侧行号、标记行内词语变化，以及可选语法高亮。其他插件可传入两段文本或预计算的 hunks 来展示差异，也可单独调用引擎构造自定义布局。适合需要在 DSH 插件中呈现文件变更或文本对比的开发者。无需 API 密钥、账号或外部服务；语法高亮依赖平台原语，不可用时显示纯文本。

dsh-diff-view gives DSH web plugins a diff engine and viewer. It renders split or unified hunks with true line numbers, word highlights, and optional syntax colors. Plugins pass texts or hunks, or build custom layouts. No API key or external service is needed; highlighting falls back to plain text.
想在自己的 DSH 插件里展示两个文本版本的差异。
有没有能并排比较修改前后内容的视图？
让 DSH 插件把代码变更按 hunk 显示并保留真实行号。
我想在差异里突出显示一行中具体改了哪些词。
DSH 里的 diff 能不能切换成统一模式？
想把多段相隔很远的修改放在同一份差异视图里，中间用折叠区提示。
I need a reusable component to compare two text versions inside a DSH client plugin.
How can I show code changes with accurate line numbers and syntax colors?
dsh-diff-view 的功能「文本差异引擎」：比较两组文本行并生成对齐结果与带上下文的 hunks。调用方传入 before 和 after 文本，可按需调整上下文行数，得到包含新旧行号的变更片段。
dsh-diff-view 的功能「差异组件」：把文本对比结果渲染为 split 或 unified 视图。插件创建组件时传入文本或 hunks，也可控制视图模式、换行和滚动等显示选项。
dsh-diff-view 的功能「行内词语标记」：对被替换的行进行词级比较，并分别标出删除与新增的词。组件在 split 和 unified 模式下都可呈现这些高亮。
dsh-diff-view 的功能「交互式变更标记」：渲染时可传入行或 hunk 标记回调，并让新增、删除行可点击。调用方接收 hunk 与行索引，以实现选择状态或分段操作。

dsh-diff-view README · dsh-diff-view：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)
plugin: a reusable two-text diff viewer for client plugins, styled after the
harness's native changed-files review. Hunk headers, true line numbers on
both sides, split or unified, word-level highlights, and optional syntax
highlighting through the same engine the native review uses.

There is no UI of its own to visit. Plugins inject the client service
`diffView`:

```js
// consumer client half, inject: ['diffView', …]

const Diff = ctx.diffView.diffFileComponent({

dsh-diff-view README · Contract：- Hunks follow the native `WorkspaceDiffHunk` shape, plus one extension:
  `unnumbered: true` draws no header and no numbers, for changes whose true
  position is unknown. Never lying numbers.
- Multiple hunks render as ONE continuous file view: when consecutive hunks
  skip lines, a gap row ("⋯ 16 unchanged lines ⋯") stands in for the hidden
  region, and a leading gap appears when the first change starts deep in the
  file. Gaps need true coordinates, so they never render beside an
  `unnumbered` hunk.
- Line numbers come from the diff itself, before any collapse, so they stay
  true across hunk boundaries.
- Syntax highlighting reuses the `useCodeHighlighter` /
  `languageForPath` primitives from the platform seed module, so colors match
  the native review. Without a path, or without the primitives, lines render
  plain. Word highlights never depend on the primitives.
- View mode is per component instance unless the consumer controls it.
- Interactive surfaces pass render props: `onLineToggle(hunkIndex, src)` with
  `isLinePicked` makes +/− rows clickable with a picked marker;
  `hunkExtras(hunkIndex)` renders a control inside that hunk's @@ head

dsh-diff-view README · How to install：Requires a DeepSeek Harness checkout and a profile, here `web`. The plugin
has no dependencies:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/dsh-plugins && cd ~/dsh-plugins
git clone https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-diff-view.git
dsh-diff-view README · from the harness checkout：pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add ~/dsh-plugins/dsh-diff-view

dsh-diff-view README · verify the profile still composes：pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Restart the harness. Plugins that inject the `diffView` service can now
render diffs.
dsh-diff-view README · Dependencies：*(none)*

dsh-diff-view README · Plugins dependent on this：- [dsh-approval-diff](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-approval-diff) renders its approval-card hunks with `diffFileComponent` and the engine
- [dsh-scratchpad](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-scratchpad) powers its `mode: 'diff'` pads with `diffFileComponent` (optional; degrades to plain text when absent)
- [dsh-wo-github](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-wo-github) renders commit patches with `diffFileComponent` (optional; falls back to the raw patch text)
